name: Mado Marks
source:
...What if the proof you existed started deleting you?

In Mado Marks, a short psychological horror visual novel, you follow a group of students who discover a door at the back of their classroom... A door that should not be there.

One day, they record vertical videos to their future selves...

The videos start as a joke. Half-cringe, half-sincere... Messages to the people they hope they might become.

Then they leave the room. It is the next morning.

The school says they were absent for an entire day. Their phones say only minutes passed. Attendance records are wrong.

And then one of them disappears...

Through subtle choices and shifting memories, decide how the remaining students respond...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4832290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
…如果你存在的证据开始删除你怎么办？

在《马多·马克斯》这部心理恐怖视觉小说中，你跟随一群学生，他们在教室后面发现了一扇门……一扇不应该在那里的门。

有一天，他们给未来的自己录制了垂直视频……

这些视频一开始只是一个笑话。一半畏缩，一半真诚……向他们希望成为的人传达的信息。

然后他们离开房间。已经是第二天早上了。

学校称他们缺席了一整天。他们的电话显示只过去了几分钟。考勤记录有误。

然后其中一个就消失了……

通过微妙的选择和不断变化的记忆，决定剩下的学生如何反应……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4832290/]Steam[/url]]
